response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT SUM(type_count) AS total_count, AVG(type_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(c.type_count) AS kept_count_sum, AVG(1.0 * c.type_count / b.total_count) AS avg_share, AVG(c.type_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_count_above_baseline FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE c.type_count > b.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: If tradekind is NULL, it forms a group under SQLite GROUP BY rules.

alternatives.interpretation: Only non-NULL trader types count as types.
